# Name: # 双固件方案（v2）：factory=三合一，ota_0=小智(xiaozhi) 固件。
# 主控页选 AI = esp_ota_set_boot_partition(ota_0) + 重启；
# 回三合一 = esp_ota_set_boot_partition(factory)（即擦除 otadata）+ 重启。
# app 分区须 64KB 对齐；store/netcfg 之后 0x328000-0x330000 留 32KB 对齐间隙。
# 0x6B0000-0x730000 unallocated: raw cover cache for the player module (512KB).
# Must stay outside every partition: IDF write-protects the running app partition.
